'''CUTIE SPHERE''' (Japanese: '''キュートなキューたい''' ''Kyūto-na Kyū-tai'') is the Japanese ending theme for the ''[[Wonder Voyage]]'' arc, and the seventh of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It will debut in [[HZ137]], replacing [[Asleep or Awake]].
